llm.summary: This skill is consistent with its stated purpose (local customer-service reply template generator), requests no credentials or exotic installs, and its included code runs locally without network or sensitive-system access.

dimensions.detail: The name/description are a customer-service reply template generator and the provided files (SKILL.md, tips.md, scripts/cs.sh) implement exactly that. No unrelated credentials, binaries, or services are requested.
dimensions.label: Purpose & Capability
dimensions.name: purpose_capability

dimensions.detail: Runtime instructions only tell the agent/user to run the included scripts locally and to consult tips.md. The scripts generate canned responses and do not instruct the agent to read unrelated system files, environment variables, or send data externally.
dimensions.label: Instruction Scope
dimensions.name: instruction_scope

dimensions.detail: No install spec is present (instruction-only + local script). The script is included in the bundle and nothing is downloaded or extracted from external URLs.
dimensions.label: Install Mechanism
dimensions.name: install_mechanism

dimensions.detail: The skill declares no required environment variables, credentials, or config paths. The code does not attempt to use secrets or networked APIs; it only invokes Python locally to generate text templates.
dimensions.label: Credentials
dimensions.name: environment_proportionality

dimensions.detail: The skill is not always-enabled and does not request persistent system changes or modify other skills/config. It runs only when invoked.
dimensions.label: Persistence & Privilege
dimensions.name: persistence_privilege

llm.guidance: This skill appears coherent and low-risk: it contains local scripts that generate customer-service replies, does not request credentials, and does not perform network activity. Recommended precautions before installing: (1) inspect SKILL.md and tips.md for hidden characters or unexpected lines (use cat -v, hexdump -C, or a text editor that shows invisibles) because the scan found Unicode control characters; (2) review scripts/cs.sh and its embedded Python (already included) to confirm there are no network calls or shell commands you didn't expect (there are none in this package); (3) run the script in a sandbox or test environment if you are risk-averse. If you see unexpected prompts for credentials or network access when running, stop and investigate further.
llm.findings: [unicode-control-chars] unexpected: The static scan detected Unicode control characters inside SKILL.md. That is not expected for a simple template/README and can sometimes be used to hide or obfuscate content. In this case the visible files and the script appear benign, but you may want to inspect SKILL.md and other files for hidden characters (e.g., zero-width spaces or bidi controls) before installing.
